In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.

Create a customer used only by this case: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Tab Co"), then Save. On its Assets tab add two assets with New Asset: "TRK-201" (e.g. 2021 Kenworth T680) and "TRK-202" (e.g. 2019 Peterbilt 579).
